title: Bullet Storm Horde
description: Weave through endless monster swarms while your auto-firing arsenal evolves into screen-filling volleys, spinning blades, and explosive skills.
controls: Drag with one finger to dodge incoming enemy waves, gather XP gems, and choose roguelike weapon upgrades.

zh-CN.title: 还有谁突突突
zh-CN.description: 满屏弹幕肉鸽割草射击：单手风骚走位自动狂射、升级进化超武大招，体验以一敌百横扫怪潮的极致爽感！
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕拖动虚拟摇杆控制走位躲怪，拾取经验宝石升级挑选强力武器词条横扫全场。
